lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَزِفُّونَ is in the derivative form: يَزِفّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ز/ف/ف z–f–f walking fast; wailing of the wind; teeth chattering; a bride’s procession. Of this root, only يَزِفّون yaziffūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَزِفّ yaziff [imperf. of v. زَفّ zaffa, intrans.] to hurry, to be in haste

(37:94) فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ they came towards him in haste.
